core.description: Base 'oc adm inspect' pass from upstream's gather script: cluster version, cluster operators, API services, CSRs, nodes, core namespaces, storage, image mirroring, networking, leases, API priority and fairness, and cluster resource quotas.

apirequestcounts.description: APIRequestCount resources plus top-20 resource and user summaries for the last 24h (needs jq in the image).

aro.description: Azure Red Hat OpenShift cluster resources. No-op on non-ARO clusters.

audit_logs.description: kube-apiserver, openshift-apiserver, oauth-apiserver, oauth-server and etcd audit logs from every master, plus prometheus-adapter/metrics-server audit logs. Can be very large.

force.help: Collect even when spec.audit.profile is None (the script otherwise refuses and exits 1).

core_dumps.description: systemd coredumps from /var/lib/systemd/coredump on every node, via oc debug. Can be very large.

out.help: Override the output directory inside the pod.

etcd.description: etcd member list, endpoint health and status, and alarm list from a running etcd pod.

etcd_more.description: Extended etcd diagnostics: per-pod endpoint data, cluster-etcd-operator state and the last 24h of etcd metrics.

frrk8s.description: FRR-K8s (openshift-frr-k8s) CRs, pod logs and FRR runtime state. No-op if not installed.

haproxy_config.description: haproxy.config from each router pod of every IngressController.

ingress_node_firewall.description: Ingress Node Firewall operator CRs and logs. No-op if the operator is not subscribed.

collector.help: oc subcommand used to pull the archives (default rsync).

istio.description: Istio / OpenShift Service Mesh and Gateway API resources. No-op if not installed.

kas_startup_termination_logs.description: kube-apiserver startup.log and termination.log (and rotated copies) from each master.

machineconfig_ondisk.description: On-disk MachineConfig content and bootstrap config diffs from nodes in a Degraded state.

machineconfigdaemon_termination_logs.description: Previous machine-config-daemon logs (/etc/machine-config-daemon/previous-logs) from every node.

metallb.description: MetalLB operator CRs, speaker/controller logs and FRR state. No-op if the operator is not subscribed.

metrics.description: Dump raw Prometheus TSDB data in OpenMetrics format. Refuses to run without at least one of min_time, max_time or match, because an unbounded dump can destabilise Prometheus.

min_time.help: Minimum timestamp to dump, in milliseconds.

max_time.help: Maximum timestamp to dump, in milliseconds.

monitoring.description: openshift-monitoring state: Prometheus and Alertmanager status, targets, rules, firing alerts and TSDB stats.

network_logs.description: Extra OVN-Kubernetes data. WARNING: this script starts by running the complete default gather, so it is a superset of every other plugin.

network_logs_basics.description: Core networking: cluster network operator, OVN-Kubernetes / SDN namespaces and pods, and network CRs.

nfd.description: Node Feature Discovery CRs and operator logs. No-op if the operator is not subscribed.

nmstate.description: kubernetes-nmstate CRs (NNCP, NNCE, NodeNetworkState) and operator logs. No-op if the operator is not subscribed.

olm.description: Operator Lifecycle Manager resources across all namespaces.

olm_v1.description: OLM v1 (olm.operatorframework.io) ClusterExtensions, ClusterCatalogs and related resources.

osus.description: OpenShift Update Service (OSUS) resources. No-op if the operator is not installed.

ppc.description: Performance profile and node tuning data: tuned profiles, kubelet config and per-node collection via the NTO image.

priority_and_fairness.description: API Priority and Fairness debug endpoints, which oc adm inspect deliberately skips.

profiling_node.description: pprof profiles from kubelet and CRI-O on nodes.

target.help: Node name to profile, or ALL (default ALL).

image.help: Support-tools image used to run the profiler.

service_logs.description: Host systemd service journals (crio, kubelet, NetworkManager, openvswitch, ...) collected with oc adm node-logs.

roles.help: Which node role(s) to collect from (default master).

services.help: Override the systemd unit list, comma separated.

sriov.description: SR-IOV Network Operator CRs, node states and operator logs. No-op if the operator is not subscribed.

virt.description: OpenShift Virtualization / KubeVirt and Forklift custom resource summaries.

vsphere.description: vSphere CSI driver CRDs and configuration. No-op on non-vSphere platforms.

windows_node_logs.description: Kubernetes component logs from Windows nodes.
